items.source_en:
___________________________
>> Reporting Party: Bellamy, Jane
>> Category: Personnel concern
___________________________

Description
On the day of the incident, Ms. Bellamy - one of our lab techs - was on leave back in Geonosis.

While at the Broken Spear bar, she was approached by Lance Corporal William Cyrus, a member of the TMD's marine detachment.

The two began fraternizing. The first of several fraternizations, apparently. 

However, upon discovering Mr. Cyrus was married, Ms. Bellamy requested a transfer. Mr. Cyrus, however, without telling Ms. Bellamy, decided he'd rather leave his wife for Ms. Bellamy, proposing - in the middle of the work day - to her.

She said "no" and reemphasized her desire for transfer to her superiors. 
___________________________
Result
>> Ms. Bellamy's request for transfer is pending.
>> Lance Corporal Cyrus has been transferred and will face appropriate disciplinary measures.
___________________________

Notation: I am suddenly reminded why I prefer to work with animals.

>> 보고자: 벨라미, 제인
>> 분류: 인사 관련
___________________________

내용
사건 당일, 연구소 기술자 중 한 명인 벨라미 씨는 지오노시스로 휴가를 떠난 상태였습니다.

그녀는 '브로큰 스피어' 술집에 머물던 중, TMD 해병대 파견대 소속인 윌리엄 사이러스 하사관의 접근을 받았습니다.

두 사람은 사적인 만남을 갖기 시작했습니다. 보아하니 그런 만남이 한두 번이 아니었던 모양입니다.

하지만 사이러스 씨가 유부남이라는 사실을 알게 된 벨라미 씨는 부서 이동을 요청했습니다. 그러나 사이러스 씨는 벨라미 씨에게 알리지도 않은 채, 아내를 버리고 벨라미 씨와 함께하기로 마음먹고는 근무 시간 중에 그녀에게 청혼했습니다.

그녀는 "아니오"라고 거절하며 상급자에게 부서 이동 의사를 재차 강조했습니다.
___________________________
결과
>> 벨라미 씨의 부서 이동 요청은 검토 중입니다.
>> 사이러스 하사관은 타 부대로 전출되었으며, 적절한 징계 조치를 받을 예정입니다.
___________________________

비고: 왜 내가 동물들과 일하는 걸 선호하는지 갑자기 깨달았군.

items.source_en:
The crew's always getting on my ass for being cheap. I don't like to tip. I've been wearing the same jacket for the past six years. And my ship's hasn't seen an upgrade since the Clone War.

So yeah, I don't like to spend more than I have to.

And there's bargains to be found everywhere, if you know where to look. When I got a tip about droids being decommissioned by the Empire, I scooped them up from the junkyard and brought them back online. The crew thinks I'm too stingy to pay for mercs, but I've had awful luck with Trandoshan and I can't afford the newer Model As.

The other option is to have no security at all, but most of us aren't combat trained, and that would be a death warrant. We aren't equipped to fight zealots, pirates, and all the other threats out there in space. These droids are.
